output:
# Stage Four Cert — Project Guide

## Overview
A minimal Node.js/Express API demonstrating JWT authentication and user management. Built with TypeScript.
**Stack**: Express, TypeScript, dotenv, jsonwebtoken

## Quick Start
```bash
# Install dependencies
npm install

# Set up environment
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env with your DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, API_KEY

# Start server
npm start
```

## Common Commands
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `npm start` | Start the server (ts-node) |
| `npm test` | No test runner configured yet |

## Architecture

### API Routes
| Route | Auth | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `GET /api/health` | — | Health check (no auth) |
| `GET /api/users` | Required | List all users |
| `GET /api/users/:id` | Required | Get a single user |

### Authentication
JWT-based Bearer token middleware in `src/auth.ts`. Protected routes require valid token in `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Public routes defined in `PUBLIC_PATHS`.

### Caching
In-memory cache via `node-cache` in `src/cache.ts`. Health check interval configurable via `HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL` env var.

### Directory Structure
```
src/
  index.ts                    — Express app entry point
  auth.ts                     — JWT middleware & verification
  cache.ts                    — In-memory cache utility
  app/api/
    health/route.ts           — GET /api/health
    users/route.ts            — GET /api/users, GET /api/users/:id
```

## Environment Variables
| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|----------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `DATABASE_URL` | Yes | — | PostgreSQL connection string |
| `JWT_SECRET` | Yes | — | Secret for signing/verifying JWTs |
| `API_KEY` | Yes | — | External API key |
| `PORT` | No | 3000 | Server port |
| `HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL` | No | 60000 | Health check cache interval (ms) |

## Key Dependencies
- **express**: Web framework
- **jsonwebtoken**: JWT signing/verification
- **dotenv**: Environment variable management
- **node-cache**: In-memory caching
- **TypeScript**: Type safety (dev only)
- **ts-node**: Runtime TypeScript execution

## Development Notes
- All routes follow `src/app/api/<resource>/route.ts` pattern
- JWT verification happens automatically via middleware on protected routes
- No database layer configured yet (ready for integration)
- Cache module ready for performance optimization
